XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Particulate matter (PM) sensor

  • Fault: Engine fault warning light illuminated

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P24C7 (Particulate sensor temperature fault), 2BB500 (Faulty particulate sensor)

  • Cause: Faulty particulate sensor

• Action: Check the condition of the particulate sensor wiring and, if necessary, restore it. If there are no faults in the wiring, check the condition of the particulate sensor and, if necessary, replace it. Then perform a forced regeneration of the particulate filter.
